## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed screening activity during October 2021, with 410 captures recorded for the month. The sessions operated as planned, apart from routine leave. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, and there were no other operational exceptions noted in the available report.

The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the site. The results below summarise the number of images that could not be graded, the proportion represented by those images, and the number of referable results.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 4.4 per cent. The rate and count should be considered together when reviewing image quality for the month. No further cause or breakdown of ungradable images is recorded in this report.

## Grading

A total of 87 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 4 days. This indicates the central grading turnaround reported for October 2021. The figures provide a concise summary of grading output and waiting time alongside the site’s activity and image-quality results.
